sentiment.label: risk_off
sentiment.reason_it: Il VIX è a 19,45, in calo del 2,70% nella settimana, ma resta sopra 18, segnalando un mercato difensivo. L'S&P 500 ha chiuso la settimana a -0,47% e il Brent è salito solo dell'1,67% mentre il DXY è in rialzo del 0,20%, indicando pressione sui risk assets. La compressione del TLT (‑0,49%) e il rialzo del US 10Y Yield (+0,71%) confermano un contesto di tassi elevati, rafforzando il sentiment risk_off.
sentiment.reason_en: The VIX sits at 19.45, down 2.70% weekly but still above 18, indicating a defensive market. The S&P 500 fell 0.47% over the week and Brent rose only 1.67% while the DXY is up 0.20%, showing pressure on risk assets. TLT compression (-0.49%) and the US 10Y yield rise (+0.71%) confirm a high‑rate environment, reinforcing a risk_off sentiment.

market_impact_summary.it: Equity: S&P 500 -0,47%, Nasdaq -0,71%, Dow +0,41%; Fixed Income: TLT -0,49% e US 10Y Yield +0,71% indicano tassi in salita; Commodities: Brent +1,67% (spike oil, ma VIX in aumento resta bearish), Gold -4,14% (pressione inflazionistica); Valute: DXY +0,20% (rafforza il dollaro, penalizza asset rischiosi). La settimana è stata dominata da tensioni geopolitiche (guerra in Ucraina, rischio Hormuz) e da un rialzo dei tassi USA, fattori che hanno spinto il sentiment verso il risk_off.
market_impact_summary.en: Equities: S&P 500 -0.47%, Nasdaq -0.71%, Dow +0.41%; Fixed Income: TLT -0.49% and US 10Y Yield +0.71% signal rising rates; Commodities: Brent +1.67% (oil spike but VIX rise stays bearish), Gold -4.14% (inflation pressure); FX: DXY +0.20% (stronger dollar, hurts risk assets). The week was shaped by geopolitical tensions (Ukraine war, Hormuz risk) and higher US rates, driving sentiment toward risk_off.

articles.title: The war in Ukraine, sanctions, and the Russian war economy
articles.snippet: Russia's war in Ukraine has now been going on for almost five years, with no end in sight. Western sanctions have hurt the Russian war economy, and it is suffering from growing structural fatigue, but the country is accelerating its attacks on Ukraine. The sanctions imposed by the US Congress under the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia Act have recently been rolled back by President Donald Trump's decision to buy Russian diesel and waive sanctions. The European Union is increasing its military, economic, and humanitarian support for Ukraine, but will it be enough? What is the actual state…

articles.title: Record Tanker Rates Cripple U.S. Crude Oil Flows to Asia
articles.snippet: The Iran war has made oil tanker voyages so inefficient that vessel availability has crumbled and freight costs have soared to record-highs, all but erasing the incentive for shipping crude oil from the U.S. Gulf Coast to Asia. The cost of shipping crude oil from the U.S. Gulf Coast to China soared to as high as $80 million earlier this month. That’s ten times the average tanker rates that had held for years before the Iran war. Freight rates have eased from the record highs seen in early October, but they were still about $60 million for…

articles.title: Fuel Oil Becomes Asia’s Next Cost Shock
articles.snippet: Singapore’s shipping-fuel market is adding another layer of cost to Asian trade. Disrupted supplies from the Middle East and Russia, resilient bunker demand and prohibitive freight rates have pushed high-sulphur fuel oil above the price of the crude used to produce it. Seasonal relief from Gulf producers and additional Chinese export allowances could ease the squeeze towards year-end, particularly for very-low-sulphur fuel oil. But with replacement cargoes expensive to transport and Russian supplies vulnerable to further disruption, a return…
